summary: Enhance your supply chain efficiency with our Data Analytics for Supply Chain Optimization Training Course. Learn to leverage data for strategic decision-making
lede: Data Analytics for Supply Chain Optimization turns transactional and operational data into actionable insights for stronger logistics performance and customer service. You will build skills in identifying ERP data quality issues, setting inventory levels with statistical formulas, mapping logistics networks, evaluating suppliers with weighted scorecards, and presenting findings to non-technical stakeholders. Using the SCOR framework, the course connects analysis to measurable supply chain performance. You will practice ARIMA demand forecasting, ABC/XYZ inventory analysis, center-of-gravity facility planning, Excel modeling, and automated KPI dashboards, while exploring Python and AI-powered demand sensing tools.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who manage the flow of goods, information, and finances across the global value chain.
modules: Supply Chain Foundations and SCOR Framework
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of supply chain concepts (procurement, logistics, or planning) and basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel. No prior programming or advanced statistical knowledge is required, as the course focuses on operational application rather than pure data science.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
